overview: Small-scale manufacturing or job-work operations (metalworking, fabrication, machine-shop work) — typically 1-10 employees, working on contract orders for other businesses rather than direct retail sale. Revenue is often irregular, tied to order flow rather than steady footfall.
red_flags_json: Client concentration risk: revenue overwhelmingly from one or two clients
A stated turnover that doesn't match the scale of machinery or premises visible in photos
No registrations at all (Udyam, trade license) despite years in operation
Heavy reliance on informal or cash-only transactions with no fallback verification
